files.model.klar:
/// Where an order is in its life.
pub enum Status {
  Draft
  Paid
  OnHold
  Packed
  Shipped
  Delivered
  Cancelled
}

pub enum Tier {
  Basic
  Silver
  Gold
}

pub enum Category {
  Book
  Toy
  Food
  Tool
  Garden
}

pub type Product {
  sku: Str
  name: Str
  price: Int
  weight: Float
  category: Category
  stock: Int
  supplier: Int
}

pub type Customer {
  id: Int
  first_name: Str
  last_name: Str
  email: Str
  tier: Tier
  city: Str
}

pub type Line {
  sku: Str
  qty: Int
  unit_price: Int
}

pub type Order {
  id: Int
  customer: Int
  lines: List[Line]
  status: Status
  shipping: Int
  day: Int
}
